integrity: The argument is an infinite symbolic proof. The nonstandard translate lemma is used exactly with its published hypotheses; all other scale estimates are standard consequences of the prime number theorem and Mertens' product theorem. No finite experiment is used as a proof.
scientific_limitations: The finite set of bases is fixed as \(X\to\infty\); no uniform estimate is claimed for growing families, no upper bound is proved, and the leading constant is not optimized.
title: Common logarithmic gaps for finitely many Romanoff bases
